content:
Here is a translation into English:

> Then in turn the lord of men, Agamemnon, spoke to him:
>
> “Laertes’ son, I am glad to have heard your speech.  
> In due measure you have gone through everything and set it out.  
> And I am willing to swear to these things, and my heart bids me so,  
> and I will not perjure myself before the god. But let Achilles  
> remain there, as he is, eager though he is for battle;  
> and let all the others remain together, until the gifts  
> come from my hut and we establish reliable oaths.  
> But to you personally I issue this command and injunction:  
> choose out, from among the chiefs of all the Achaeans,  
> the men to bring from my ship the gifts that we recently agreed  
> to give Achilles, and to fetch the women.  
> And let Talthybius quickly through the wide army of the Achaeans  
> make ready a boar to cut up, for Zeus and for Helios.”
